echo_sets.name: Flaming Clawprint
echo_sets.note: Casting Resonance Liberation grants all Resonators 15% Fusion DMG Bonus and the caster 20% Liberation DMG Bonus for 35s; Lioness of Glory main echo adds 12% Fusion DMG and 12% Liberation DMG Bonus.

echo_sets.name: Molten Rift
echo_sets.note: 30% increased Fusion DMG on Liberation activation; a solid second choice (older, widely farmed set), though it lengthens her field time.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Outro-Skill energy/damage support set usable if Flaming Clawprint or Molten Rift pieces are unavailable.

build.fast_path: Lupa runs 5-pc Flaming Clawprint (43311) with Lioness of Glory as the 4-cost main echo, on her signature Wildfire Mark. Build Crit on the 4-cost, Fusion DMG Bonus on the 3-costs, and ATK% on the 1-costs; open with Resonance Liberation to trigger Pack Hunt/Glory and her weapon's team-wide Fusion buff, then rotate through her Wolflame/Wolfaith combo and Outro to the next Fusion DPS.

ranked_weapons.name: Wildfire Mark
ranked_weapons.note: BiS — Crit DMG substat, personal Liberation DMG, and a team-wide Fusion DMG Bonus triggered by her Heavy Attack extension; tailor-made for her Liberation-swap loop.

ranked_weapons.name: Verdant Summit
ranked_weapons.note: Crit DMG substat and Heavy Attack DMG boosts after Intro/Liberation — synergizes with her Heavy-Attack-heavy pattern.

ranked_weapons.name: Ages of Harvest
ranked_weapons.note: Strong hybrid option: Crit Rate substat plus Attribute/Resonance Skill DMG bonuses from Intro and Skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Lustrous Razor
ranked_weapons.note: Standard 5-star: Energy Regen plus Liberation DMG stacks from Resonance Skill — good uptime and sustained damage.

ranked_weapons.name: Autumntrace
ranked_weapons.note: Battle-pass 4-star with Crit Rate; Basic/Heavy hits stack ATK%. Best non-5-star crit option.

ranked_weapons.name: Waning Redshift
ranked_weapons.note: F2P-friendly: Resonance Skill grants Energy and ATK% — supports her dual buffer/damage role.

ranked_weapons.name: Discord
ranked_weapons.note: Grants up to 16 Concerto Energy, shortening her on-field time and speeding up rotations.

stat_priorities.note: Match whichever balances your crit ratio; Lioness of Glory in the main slot.
Fusion DMG Bonus preferred on both 3-cost pieces (Pilgrim's Shell / Kerasaur class).

profile.role_note: Fusion team buffer; Resonance Liberation grants team-wide Pack Hunt (DMG%) and Glory (Fusion RES ignore); Outro Skill grants the next Resonator +20% Fusion DMG and +25% Basic Attack DMG.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists); her most recent rerun was in Version 3.1 Phase 1
pull_verdict.verdict: Lupa is the core support engine of mono-Fusion teams and a rare example of a 5-star buffer with genuine personal damage. Pull her if you play Fusion carries (Galbrena, Changli, Brant) — she measurably elevates all of them. If you have no Fusion investment, skip; her value is concentrated in that archetype.

members.name: Galbrena
members.note: Fusion main DPS; Lupa's Pack Hunt/Glory and Outro Fusion buffs feed her Demon Hypostasis windows.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Healer plus team-wide buffs and Outro; note any non-Fusion member slightly reduces Lupa's ATK buffs.

members.name: Lupa
members.note: Fusion buffer via Liberation Pack Hunt/Glory with solid personal damage on her Wolflame combo.

teams.name: Premium: Galbrena + Shorekeeper + Lupa
teams.rotation: Open on Lupa: build Wolflame, then cast Resonance Liberation to activate Pack Hunt and Glory. Outro into Galbrena so she carries the Fusion/Basic Attack buffs into her Demon Hypostasis window, weaving Echo Skills and Heavy Attacks. When her window ends, rotate Shorekeeper for healing and team buffs, then back to Lupa to rebuild Wolflame, refresh Liberation buffs, and repeat.

members.name: Lupa
members.note: Fusion buffer and secondary damage; keeps all three Fusion characters stacked for max Glory value.

members.name: Mortefi
members.note: Fusion sub-DPS whose off-field damage and Outro Heavy Attack buff pair with Lupa's buffs.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Fusion support keeping the team mono-element so Lupa's full ATK/Glory buffs apply.

teams.name: Alternative: Mortefi + Mornye + Lupa
teams.rotation: Start on Lupa: Wolflame combo into Resonance Liberation for Pack Hunt/Glory, then Outro. Rotate through Mortefi's Liberation and Resonance Skill windows and Mornye's support uptime, returning to Lupa to refresh her Liberation buffs. Keep all three Fusion members cycling so Glory's Fusion RES ignore stays at full stacks.
